jobs.title: Head of Data Systems (Google Stack)
jobs.description:
The Head of Data Systems (Google Stack) will play a key role at Stacktics, required to help create and maintain industry-leading quality and efficiency of service and software delivery.

Stacktics will rely on the Head of Data Systems with ownership of the Data Systems function including mentoring and support for our team of engineers, developers, marketing analysts and data scientists. The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals
Maintain continuous focus on work output quality and reliability, acting as the champion of customer satisfaction in a proactive manner and as the final escalation point for technical and delivery issues that cannot be resolved at the Technical Lead level
Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks
Contributing to deployment tooling within the Stacktics team
Contributing to version control technology frameworks and creating/implementing working processes within the Data Systems team, with tools such as Git or SVN
Own and continuously improve the practice's AI coding standards, the AI coding constitution (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules), PR checklists, and slash commands keeping them current as tools, clients, and the team's needs evolve

Leading in the Software 3.0 Era

AI tools have changed how fast engineering work gets produced. Your job is to make sure that speed shows up as sounder architecture and higher-quality delivery — not just faster shipping of the same judgment gaps.
Recalibrate how the team scopes and estimates work as AI tooling changes what can actually be delivered in a sprint, so timelines and resourcing plans reflect real AI-era delivery speed
Set architecture and coding standards that assume engineers are using AI assistants daily — code review habits, eval frameworks, and quality gates sized to the failure modes of AI-assisted development, not just its speed
Continue evolving Stacktics' AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — our AI-native answer to SDLC — piloting new stages against real engagements and driving adoption across the team
Be an active daily user of AI coding assistants yourself, and bring that firsthand experience into how standards and review practices are set for the team
Lead Stacktics’ technical team members through the integration into Agentic AI-first working patterns, and beyond

Code Productization

Migrating the delivery of the most common/universally applicable solutions from custom projects to formally productized software solutions
Advocating for building repeatability, scalability and standardization into how the Stacktics Data Systems team approaches all work, in order to enable the future migration to productization as a general rule

Data Engineering-Specific Responsibilities

Participate in continuous delivery pipelines to fully automate deployment of the highly available cloud platform that supports multiple projects
Design and develop ETL workflows and datasets to be used in data visualization tools
Write complex SQL queries with multiple joins to automate and manipulate data extracts
Perform end to end Data Validation to maintain accuracy of data sets
Build tools for deployment, monitoring and operations
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the development, test and production environments
Develop re-usable processes that can be leveraged and standardized for multiple instances
Prepare technical specifications and documentation for projects
Stay up to date on relevant technologies, plug into user groups, understand trends and opportunities to ensure we are using the best possible techniques and tools
Understand, implement, and automate security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation

Contribution to Corporate Strategy

Actively and proactively play a key role in steering Stacktics and affiliated companies, considering market developments, competitive maneuvers, unique opportunities, etc.
You will be expected to both bring new ideas to the table and assist other corporate leaders in vetting/developing concepts and tactics
Identification and tracking of performance, coaching, training needs, and motivating members of the Data Systems team — including Senior Technical Leads. Directly or indirectly responsible for hiring, terminating and owning performance evaluations for direct reports and the Data Systems group

Company-Wide Responsibilities

Maintain and exceed client satisfaction with Stacktics’ deliverables, day-to-day work and overall value as a partner
Adapt to ever-changing client needs and expectations
Maintain dedication toward achieving excellence in Stacktics’ delivery against client needs, and overall success as an organization
Ability to provide clear guidance and support for advanced problem solving and system design to large teams at enterprise-level client companies, aiding the evolution of their digital practices

QUALIFICATIONS

Deep expertise in building and managing large-scale data systems on cloud platforms, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services
Python, SQL and Cloud Computing
10+ years experience in Data Engineering, including 6+ years in technical leadership or management roles, with experience managing other leads (e.g., Technical Leads or engineering managers).
Strong understanding of and direct experience with managing a team operating in a “Software 3.0” model (Agentic AI-first)
Active user of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent), and fluent in what they change about estimation, architecture, and review
Understanding of digital ecosystems including online data collection, cloud systems and analytics tools (Google Stack, Facebook, Salesforce, Adobe Suite etc.) a strong asset
Strong technical understanding of a range of marketing concepts such as cookie-based data collection, setting and leveraging audience segments, attribution modelling, AB/N & multivariate is an asset
Excellent written & verbal communication skills are essential; candidate should be comfortable presenting and participating in group discussions of concepts with internal and external stakeholders
Candidate must exhibit an analytical, detail-oriented approach to problem solving
Experience with Jira / Atlassian project management tools is an asset

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer) are a strong plus.
Prior experience in a consulting environment, managing and delivering projects for multiple clients concurrently.

jobs.title: Vice President of AI Engineering
jobs.description:
About Patra

Patra is an outcome-focused operating partner working exclusively for the insurance industry. Combining expert global teams, process intelligence, and purpose-built technology, Patra delivers measurable results to clients. With 20 years of deep domain expertise, exceptional client retention rates, and significant sustained investment in AI, Patra partners with agencies, brokers, MGAs, MGUs, and carriers to transform how insurance operations are delivered.

About Role

Patra is seeking a VP of Engineering to lead the technology organization behind our software platform and AI products. This executive will own the technical roadmap, build and scale a high-performing engineering team across Patra's global footprint, and drive the company's AI and automation initiatives from early prototypes to production at scale. Seeking a leader who can build solutions for forward deployed squads, building strong relationships with Forward Deployed Squad (FDS), ensuring their code and agents and templates will need to be engineered to be useful and applicable for FDS squad.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical roadmap for Patra's software platform and AI products
Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering organization spanning multiple geographies
Set engineering standards for quality, security, reliability, and delivery speed, backed by clear metrics
Drive AI and automation initiatives from prototype to production at scale
Manage engineering budget, vendors, technology investments and relationships

Qualifications & Experience

12+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant time in VP-level or senior engineering leadership roles
Proven track record building and scaling distributed engineering organizations across multiple geographies (onshore/offshore delivery models a plus)
Demonstrated success shipping AI or automation-driven products from prototype through production at scale
Strong technical background in software platform architecture for SaaS or enterprise systems
Experience owning an engineering budget, vendor relationships, and technology investment decisions
Insurance, financial services, or BPO industry experience a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree a plus

Preferred Experience:

Experience with agentic software development in an AI native environment where agents do the coding, testing, deployment, updates, bug fixing and feature releases.
Seeking a leader who can build solutions for forward deployed squads so they can hit the ground running, working closely with internal teams

Patra Corporation is an equal opportunity employer committed to celebrating diversity and creating a safe and inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Director - Governance & Client Account Management
jobs.description:
Permanent

Department: FSD Client Management (520)

30 Adelaide Str, East

Toronto, Ontario, M5C 3G9

Canada

Number of Positions: 1

Who We Are

With its global headquarters in Toronto, Canada, International Financial Data Services (IFDS) is a world-leading provider of outsourcing and technology solutions to the financial services industry. IFDS services over 240 financial organizations around the world, providing solutions to a wide range of global asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and insurance companies. The IFDS enterprise supports more than 17 million accounts with AUA of approximately CAD $4 trillion. IFDS Canada is a 50/50 joint ventures between Boston-based State Street Corporation, one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, and Connecticut-based SS&C Technologies, a global provider of investment and financial software-enabled services and software for the global financial services and healthcare industries.

Imagine yourself at IFDS

Come experience a community like no other at International Financial Data Services (IFDS). We offer work opportunities driven by a passion for creating market leading financial solutions, and a culture that nurtures collaboration, accountability, diversity & inclusion, and continuous learning. We’ll provide you with opportunities to develop your career. From ongoing training and development programs to experiences working with our global financial services partners, you’ll be able to realize your full potential.

Role Overview

The Governance Director – Client Account Management provides day to day oversight; guidance and strategic leadership to our client and the broader support team at IFDS and SS&C through close collaboration with the Business Development Relationship Manager, the AMS team, IT Departments; the Business Solutions and Planning team and C-Suite individuals to ensure the delivery of superior service commitments aligned with client goals. The incumbent will own the overall oversight of key initiatives and changes impacting the client, identifying risks and issues and will be responsible for the timely closure of all remediation actions. The Director will provide guidance and leadership, coaching and development to managers and employees to ensure that clients are supported with high quality solutions tailored to their business needs.

Governance

Role Responsibilities

Oversee a virtual support team consisting of both IFDS and SS&C individuals dedicated to the overall successful delivery of changes.
Build and maintain a governance practice consisting of key reporting and metrics tracking all initiatives/changes / issues - identifying and addressing risks and issues to continuously enhance service, client relationships and improve operational efficiencies.
Acts as an escalation point for the client re any key changes.
Lead the identification and documentation of risks and controls across changes and initiatives (projects, service requests, incidents and adhoc initiatives such as proactive testing of complex functionality).
Elevate the profile and product knowledge of clients by providing deep expertise in risk and controls in conjunction with virtual support team.
Implement an internal/ external forum/s to meet regularly with the “virtual” support teams (and the client) to provide and discuss status of changes/issues and hold teams accountable to timely resolution and remediation actions.
Ongoing assessment of venues / documentation and ensures all processes serve a key purpose and align with client and IFDS requirements. E.g. any “special client reporting” from CAMs – Vendor Scorecard; Usage reporting; Utilization reporting etc. Delivers to client (along with new findings/solutions etc)
Ongoing review processes/operating model etc. to ensure “we evolve our processes and engagement” aligned with iA’s evolution in business growth and strategy
Overseas the SLA adherence and smooth delivery of client requests, to ensure delivery is in accordance with client expectations
Work directly with the client and internal teams to ensure clarity and organization of all changes and release/ delivery dates.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, business partners to ensure effective collaboration and communication.
Drive change management initiatives, guiding the team through evolving operational risk management standards and expectations.
Foster a team environment and culture that encourages productivity, innovation, process improvement, and professionalism.

Account Management Service Delivery

Oversees day-to-day issue resolution and all critical reoccurring processes for clients, which includes planning and execution of the overall client service delivery experience in collaboration with all internal and external clients to oversee the delivery of superior customer service in alignment with the client’s strategic goals 
Interacts directly with key business partners, developing and maintaining a strong on-going relationship; always looking for opportunities to improve client satisfaction and experience
Facilitates and leads various internal / client meetings (virtually and / or in person) as it relates to the mandate and participates in all key reoccurring meetings regarding TLR; Release Management; JAD sessions; client reviews
Oversees the various aspects of client business operations, regulatory, statutory and industry standards bodies to understand and ensure appropriate and timely communication of business requirements for client consumption in collaboration with internal and external teams
Acts as an escalation point for Client Account Managers on incidents/service requests and the client if resolution is not attained timely / accurately
Supports Business Development & Relationship Management with new product onboarding opportunities as required.

Leadership and People Management

Completes performance reviews; successions plans; establishing objectives in monitoring performance against plans; promotes training and professional development. Works closely with Human Resources on talent management
Provides performance feedback, coaching, mentoring and career and development planning for team members
Ensures continued employee engagement by promoting an “in the office presence” through participation in IFDS events; team meetings and events; internal working groups
Reviews current operating procedures, revising and implementing changes to improve service levels, productivity and cost effectiveness
Maintains current knowledge of financial; regulatory and operational issues affecting other departments and the company as a whole. Understands financial and operational goals of IFDS
Provides the team with support and recommendations on project prioritization and resource management
Oversees and provides the team guidance and direction with new opportunities with the development and discussion of operational enhancements to improve the client experience which may include but not limited to guidance with approach; test strategy and developing test plan and cases
Oversees and provides the team guidance and direction with new processes, policies and special initiatives as needed to enhance and support business needs.
Assists VP Account Management with salary administration; capacity planning and staffing plans

Minimum Qualifications

Demonstrated superior leadership skills including collaboration; relationship building; coaching; integrity; resilience to a fast paced; high stress environment; ownership and accountability, credibility, and consensus building
Demonstrated proficiency in communicating complex business solutions with clients & internal stakeholders
Solid technical knowledge of IFDS applications (including iFast, IFWP, etc).
Good knowledge of Segregated Fund, RESP, GIA/DIA, Guarantee Fee, FHSA product/iFast functionality.
Strong Change Management capability (ADKAR)
Highly analytical with a very high degree of attention to detail
Strong research / information gathering / analytical and problem-solving skills - takes a logical approach to analyzing problems. Systematically researches information and explores alternatives to solve problems.
Post-secondary education in a related discipline
Minimum 10 years’ experience in the financial service industry in a client facing, relationship management or Operational capacity
Minimum 10 years’ experience in leadership/people management
Solid knowledge of financial mutual fund record keeping systems and transfer agency operations
In depth knowledge of the mutual fund and banking industry of financial investment markets, trends and competitive framework
Understanding of investment concepts and the ability to communicate a working knowledge of investment strategies and products
High level of competency with MS suite, including but not limited to; Excel, Visio, Word, Powerpoint.
Superior communication verbal and written skills, as well as high level of interpersonal skill to interact with senior business professionals
Ability to engage internal stakeholders across a number of different functional areas
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem solving/troubleshooting skills combined with the ability to draw meaningful conclusions from qualitative client feedback or large data sets
Demonstrated ability to innovate and develop new proposals/solutions
Ability to manage direct and indirect reports in a virtual team setting
Proven project management skills, with strong attention to detail and flexibility to handle multiple projects and changing priorities
Enthusiastic and proactive approach with meticulous attention to detail
Extensive experience working with IFDS tools and clients (understands the full picture) Able to handle or lead (as appropriate)complex projects major change

AODA Statement

IFDS Canada encourages applications from all qualified individuals. Applicants with disabilities may notify us of any accommodation needed to support your participation in the recruitment process. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying. Please be aware that only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted for this position.

Salary Range

Pay Range (CAD $): 126,000 - 159,000

The above reflects an industry-benchmarked target compensation range. The salary offered may vary based upon the candidate’s skills and experience, job-related knowledge, and other specific business needs.

IFDS Provides

Total Rewards: IFDS offers a comprehensive, competitive compensation & benefits package
Work-Life Balance: IFDS offers a hybrid work environment with our office located in the downtown core within walking distance to Union Station and the PATH
Professional Development: IFDS offers continuous learning opportunities, leadership development & training programs
Inclusive Culture: Our inclusive work environment supports equity and values diversity
Wellness Programs: Access to a variety of wellness initiatives, mental health support, and employee assistance programs
Community Engagement: Participate in volunteer opportunities and give back to our community through our various social care programs

Section:
Client Experience Operations

jobs.title: Financial Director
jobs.description:
The Company

Our client is a global and growth-focused organization seeking an experienced Director of Finance to lead and develop the finance function for a new Canadian business unit. This is a key executive leadership position offering the opportunity to influence strategic direction, strengthen financial performance, and support continued business growth through sound financial management and business partnering.

The Role

Reporting to senior executive leadership, the Director of Finance is responsible for the overall strategic, operational, and leadership oversight of the Finance function. The role ensures strong financial governance, reporting accuracy, compliance, and financial decision support across the organization.

As a trusted advisor to executive management, Group Finance, and key business stakeholders, you will build a scalable and high-performing finance organization that drives transparency, operational excellence, value creation, and sustainable growth.
You must be comfortable leading a new Finance team in a startup environment. You will help create financial processes, internal controls and financial reporting from the ground up. This role is best suited to someone who can effectively operate in chaotic environments with the goal of creating a world class manufacturing facility.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy

Develop and execute the company's finance strategy in alignment with overall business objectives.
Provide strategic financial leadership and support executive decision-making.
Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and multi-year business plans.
Define, monitor, and report on key financial and operational performance indicators.
Drive financial performance reviews and support data-driven business decisions.

Financial Management & Reporting

Oversee all financial reporting activities, ensuring timely and accurate weekly, monthly, and annual reporting.
Maintain full responsibility for profit and loss management, balance sheet integrity, cash flow, and financial KPIs.
Ensure robust financial controls, governance frameworks, and compliance with accounting standards and company policies.
Manage relationships with external auditors, banks, insurers, and other financial stakeholders.

Business Partnering & Performance Optimization

Partner closely with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and People & Culture leaders to improve business performance.
Identify and drive cost optimization, efficiency improvements, and profitability initiatives across the organization.
Support investment decisions through financial modelling, business cases, and risk assessments.
Promote a strong performance-oriented and data-driven culture.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach, and develop the Finance team to ensure high levels of performance, engagement, and accountability.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, processes, and decision-making frameworks.
Foster collaboration and continuous capability development within the finance function.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

Strengthen internal controls, risk management practices, and financial compliance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reporting processes, systems, tools, and ways of working.
Ensure lessons learned, root cause analysis, and performance reviews support organizational learning and continuous development.

Your Profile

Significant leadership experience within finance, ideally in manufacturing, food production, or CPG industry.
Proven track record of leading finance functions and delivering business performance improvements.
Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, strategic planning, and financial performance management.
Sound understanding of governance, compliance, financial controls, and risk management.
Experience supporting operational leadership teams in a fast-paced business environment.
Knowledge of ERP and Business Intelligence platforms, ideally SAP and related reporting tools.
Strong analytical and commercial acumen with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Executive presence and perfect communication skills as this individual will be client-facing and regularly meet with Senior Leadership in Canada and at Head Office in Europe.
10+ years of experience including minimum 5 years as Controller.
CPA designation or MBA is required.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic, structured, and results-oriented leader.
High integrity with a strong ethical and professional approach.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong business acumen with the ability to influence at executive level.
Resilient and adaptable, with the ability to manage complexity and change.
Passionate about developing people and building high-performing teams.
Collaborative, hands-on, and focused on delivering practical business outcomes.

What's on Offer

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing organization in a highly visible leadership role. You will have the chance to shape the financial direction of the business, influence strategic decisions, and lead a talented finance team while contributing to the company's long-term success and growth.
